architecture: Same18 explicit physical gate states, V/Ca inputs, dt0.1ms, unchanged algebraic current readout. No canonical rate formula at candidate inference. Base factorized V-only and Ca-only SK heads. Grouped variant uses16 shared+8 rapid+8 slow hidden units and a fixed fit-only coefficient-based output connectivity mask. Multiscale variant uses fixed equal mixture of four sigmoid offsets0,-3,-6,-9, shifted to match base fraction at raw=-3; no extra learned parameters. SK remains Ca-only. All variants retain convex bounded updates.
matrix: 8 base arms: recurrent horizon8/64 ticks x collocation off/on x relative-current auxiliary off/on. Two architecture variants each at8/off/off and64/on/on add4 arms;36 independent members. Architecture/training interaction tested only on these two anchors, not a full architectural factorial.
training: All members see the same16 contiguous64-tick windows/update,1024 target ticks. Short arms reset to the supplied pre-state every8 ticks; long arms only at tick0. Fit/fit_extra histories mixed50/50 with common draws. Collocation replaces25percent of windows with identical V/Ca and independently sampled initial physical gate states, propagated offline by the exact teacher. Short collocation arms reset to collocation teacher states, never trajectory states. Replacement target count is equal, no extra targets. Windows have64-tick support, so short control is not an exact replay of Task39 sampler. Same nominal parameter count, different effective connectivity/activation; no pure-capacity or speed claim.
selection: At each checkpoint common development-only score=max over12 families and short8/full512 tick losses, gate normalized MSE plus individual-current normalized MSE. Same selection for every arm; auxiliary relative loss not used to select. Earliest minimum. Long physical recurrence through10s only after freeze; stress already-open diagnostics, never confirmation. Frozen Task39 factorized_expanded_fr and old coefficient baseline retained.
quality: Task37 evaluator and all numerical thresholds unchanged; no Task40 promotion without all development criteria and audit. Timing, charge, occupancy, blocking and history differences retained. New independent confirmation not accessed.
contrasts: 12 factorial edges (4 peraxis),4 architecture contrasts against corresponding base anchors. Paired3 seed severity medians and worst cases; support requires median ratio<=0.8, all3<1 and worst ratio<=1.05. Timing/occupancy remain strict pass even though severity excludes timing. Report interactions descriptively without population significance.
probes: Per-gate candidate/fraction, affine equilibrium and slope, cross-state independence, gradient norms, off-trajectory random-state error, history contrast, current strata, horizon errors and event timing details. Fit-only rapid/slow assignment from median teacher fractions; not a claim of universal physiological classes. Inspect event traces on diagnostic cases. Mini budget curves with common selection score. Actual optimizer updates, target counts, wall time and peak GPU memory recorded separately; no inference speedup from training throughput.
preflights: Dataset/checkpoint hashes; phase and collocation teacher agreement; boundary reset semantics; bounds and cross-state invariance; batched/isolated Adam and clipping all seeds/architectures; CUDA graph recurrent equivalence; captured training two-step equivalence including independent optimizer state. Runtime benchmark before budget with state fully reset; fail technical violations before training.
limits: Diagnoses a constrained ionic transition, not full compartment. No autonomous V/Ca, no emergent spike/bifurcation certification, no speedup demonstrated. Fixed60k budget, not unlimited scaling. Architectural changes do not guarantee success and no threshold relaxation authorized. Task39b does not renumber Task40.
